steps.title: Lesson 2: Core Concepts
steps.body: Key Fact: The 4 Cs of food safety are: Cross-contamination prevention, Cleaning, Chilling, and Cooking. | Key Fact: Cross-contamination prevention: use separate boards, wash hands after handling raw meat, store raw foods below cooked foods. | Key Fact: Cleaning: wash and disinfect all surfaces, equipment, and hands before and after food preparation. | Key Fact: Chilling: keep the fridge at 0–5°C, the freezer at −18°C or below; never put hot food directly in the fridge.
